responsibility: Contains the machine description scheduling model for AMD Athlon-family processors, extended to cover closely related K8 and amdfam10 timing cases through shared attributes and reservations. In GCC’s i386 backend this file defines decode classifications, automata, cpu units, reservations, and bypass-relevant latency/throughput data for integer, load/store, x87, and SSE instruction classes, allowing the scheduler to estimate issue constraints and pipeline costs for these AMD cores.
